oauth_providers.note: OAuth providers (Google, Apple) referenced in code via signInWithOAuth but NOT confirmed active in Supabase dashboard

jwt_configuration.note: Supabase manages JWT secret — NOT EXPORTABLE

mfa.note: MFA NOT enabled in this project

user_profile_mapping.description: auth.users ↔ public.profiles is a strict 1:1 relationship
user_profile_mapping.created_by: TRIGGER on_auth_user_created → public.handle_new_user() fires on EVERY auth.users INSERT
user_profile_mapping.role_management: public.profiles.role — managed by admin RPCs set_user_role()
user_profile_mapping.deletion_cascade: ON DELETE CASCADE from auth.users → profiles, devices, enrollments, credits, notifications

auth_tables.reason: Supabase-managed auth schema — not directly exportable. User records available via Supabase Dashboard or service_role API

password_export_status.plaintext_passwords: NOT EXPORTABLE — never stored in plaintext
password_export_status.password_hashes: NOT ACCESSIBLE via SQL — stored in auth.users.encrypted_password using bcrypt format ($2a$10$...) but Supabase does NOT expose this column via the API or SQL editor
password_export_status.bcrypt_compatibility: If hashes WERE accessible, the $2a$10$ bcrypt format IS compatible with PHP password_verify() — PHP's password_verify() supports $2a$, $2b$, $2y$ prefixes
password_export_status.migration_recommendation: Users must reset passwords on migration OR use Supabase Admin API to export hashes if Supabase provides a data export feature in your plan

auth_triggers.name: on_auth_user_created
auth_triggers.purpose: Create public.profiles + public.credits row for every new auth user

auth_triggers.name: on_auth_user_deleted
auth_triggers.purpose: Cleanup hook — cascade deletes handled by FK ON DELETE CASCADE

admin_auth_functions: admin-update-email — Edge Function (uses service_role to call auth.admin.updateUserById)
bootstrap-super-admin — Edge Function (creates initial admin via auth.admin.createUser)
bulk-user-ops — Edge Function (bulk password reset, uses auth.admin.generateLink)
impersonate — Edge Function (generates impersonation session token)
